meta.rationale: Iteration 1 — the milestone-1 keyword-search baseline is validated. The report-side probe (report.json `keyword`) scores the non-learned inverted-index kw predictor directly on data/cldr.jsonl: exact-postings Acc@1 = 0.966, which clears the priority-1 gate (>= 0.95). The remaining open gate is full-text emoji Acc@1 (emoji.eval, best fusion variant = Fusion.Gain, 0.538). Sub-signals watched but not gated: model-only CLDR Acc@1 (0.312 — the encoder has not learned bare keyword->emoji, expected for milestone 1) and fusion Acc@1 on CLDR (0.680 — the shipped combiner drags the clean kw ranking down; combiner routing is recommend-only).
